status: proposal; source extraction only; not a runnable aircraft or adopted production data
aircraft: Supermarine Spitfire VA, NACA Langley test installation
source_reading: Original NASA PDFs: embedded prose OCR read; independent scan OCR used for ambiguous text. L334 printed p.2/PDF4 and L353 printed p.7/PDF9 scans directly visually reviewed. No flight-curve digitization or original-data uncertainty estimate is claimed.

L334.title: Measurements of the Flying Qualities of a Supermarine Spitfire VA Airplane
L334.pagination: Printed prose page n is NASA PDF page n+2; introduction is unnumbered printed page 1. Figures require their own PDF-page citation.

L353.title: Stalling Characteristics of the Supermarine Spitfire VA Airplane
L353.pagination: Printed prose page n is NASA PDF page n+2.

identity_source.location: General specifications; serial resolved by independent scan OCR

configuration.power_loading_caution: The report does not identify the power denominator of 4.78; it differs from normal gross weight divided by the separately listed ratings. Preserve this source value without using it to infer a different engine power.

reported_wing.note: Quoted from this report's configuration list, not supplemented from later-variant handbooks. Airfoil names alone do not supply measured section polars or section geometry tolerances.

cg.caution: Both CG/MAC statements are approximate. NACA lacked accurate drawings and explicitly warned that computed MAC location might be in error. Do not force rounded inch dimensions to reproduce 31.4% exactly.

source.location: General specifications: ailerons; covering also stated on printed page 12

engine.caution: These are reported specification ratings, not measured installed power maps or continuous sea-level power. Normal-rating RPM resolved by independent scan OCR; no power curve is inferred.

measurement_contract.airspeed: Keep pilot-indicated airspeed, NACA correct indicated airspeed and true airspeed separate. L334 printed pp.4-5 (PDF6-7), airspeed calibration/fig.7; L353 printed p.2 (PDF4), fig.5. Calibration used formation flight with a trailing-head-calibrated reference aircraft. Pilot indication was about 10 mph low near minimum speed and depended on sideslip; no universal +10 mph correction is justified.
measurement_contract.roll_helix: pb/(2V): p in rad/s, b span, V TRUE airspeed, L334 printed p.13 (PDF15). Body angular rate may need transformation to the reported roll observable; state convention explicitly.
measurement_contract.control_positions: Recorded near cockpit linkages; L334 printed p.4 (PDF6) reports uncorrected aileron flexibility. Total aileron deflection is the sum of right/left deflection magnitudes, not one surface angle.
measurement_contract.force: Reported lbf acts at the pilot stick or cable system. Existing normalized commands/actuator torque are different observables; a declared linkage/force mapping is needed before comparing them.
measurement_contract.lift: Reported CL is a whole-aircraft result in specified powered/configuration conditions. Do not install it as a 2-D cell polar or derive a universal stall AoA. No section-polar, flap, slipstream, downwash or material-law adoption is authorized by this file.

source.location: Unnumbered maximum-lift table; covered and open gun-port columns visually verified

candidate_targets.comparison: Keep speed label exactly as source: indicated stalling speed, not TAS or an assumed calibrated/equivalent speed. Resolve recorder/cockpit convention and atmosphere before a speed match or lift reconstruction. Powered whole-aircraft CL includes slipstream/trim effects; compare integrated aircraft behavior, not a section CLmax. Ports-open is a source contrast, not a damage law.

candidate_targets.conditions: Metal-covered ailerons, low-speed full travel; report discusses landing and flaps/gear-up level-flight measurements. Exact speed/configuration points require figure digitization before an exact reproduction test.
candidate_targets.comparison: First compare sign, attainable surface travel and dimensionless roll scale. Keep left/right labels separate from the core sign convention.

candidate_targets.conditions: Source says approximately half available travel at 300 mph. Speed calibration/atmosphere and physical pilot-force/linkage mapping must be resolved for a numerical flight comparison.
candidate_targets.comparison: Increasing dynamic pressure must reduce attainable actual surface angle for fixed physical pilot force. Do not impose a scripted roll-rate limit.

candidate_targets.conditions: Reported accelerated maneuvers from level flight, flaps up. Do not average the two reports into a new measured value or interpret their difference as a statistical uncertainty/tolerance. Gun-port state changes later lateral behavior; preserve that distinction.
candidate_targets.comparison: Measure whole-aircraft lift and local stall/control response on a separately declared matching configuration, rather than replacing cell CLmax. No fracture load can be inferred: high-speed pull-ups were eased to avoid structural overload (L334 printed p.8/PDF10).

candidate_targets.conditions: Throttle closed; flaps/gear up; radiator shutter and hood closed; gun ports covered. Slowly reduce speed with wings initially level and heading held; distinguish held-control and continued-up-elevator tests.
candidate_targets.comparison: Root separation/buffet precedes the minimum-speed state, with flow ahead of ailerons remaining attached in these trials and useful lateral control beyond stall. Gun ports open are a different test condition, not generic damage calibration. Buffet frequencies were deliberately not reproduced in report plots; do not extract a natural frequency from them.

missing_for_production_profile: Source-matched installed mass and 3-D component geometry; the report outline dimensions do not determine load-path sections. No interpolation from another variant.
Mass distribution/full inertia, installed thrust/power versus speed/altitude/setting, blade sections/pitch limits and governor parameters.
2-D section polars and explicit finite-span/slipstream/downwash/flap/trim-tab models; the named whole-aircraft observations do not supply them.
Local spar/skin/root geometry and thickness, alloy/temper/product form, EI/GJ/I/J/Z and yield/fracture/fatigue calibration. These flight reports are not structural destruction tests.
Source-matched full figure coordinates and defensible measurement/comparison tolerances; no historical matching test has run.
